notes.title: The Final Hours of Power of Two
notes.content:
[h2]Power of Two was conceived as a debut duet project: very simple, short, and fun.[/h2]
[h3]As the first step on the long road.[/h3] 

Now we think we've achieved everything ever wanted from it with the main aim to ensure: 
We can create something valuable (playable) together!

So it's the best time to release it and do the next step.

Currently, the game has 5 tutorial levels and 10 main levels, and also a bunch of unlockable gameplay modifiers - enough to make one of your evenings funnier, we hope :)

We've learned many things from it, and we will use these skills and knowledge for the greater good (for the next project, in particular).

[b]Thanks to everyone who participated in this development in any role: our dear playtesters, Early Access players, our families, close and beloved people.[/b]

And thanks in advance to every player who will play Power of Two.

Finally, to make this moment more festive - 50% release discount for everyone! Wo-hoo!

See you later!

[i]Always yours,
Power of Two team[/i]

notes.title: Patch note 0.1.3
notes.content:
[h1]It's time to go further[/h1]

[h2]This project was conceived as a small one. Let it remain so.[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] "New Game+" after finishing all levels.
[*] Dash is reworked for better feeling and collision behavior.
[*] Player movement speed, acceleration, and deceleration are increased.
[*] Dead players now can move.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect movement direction while moving with arrow keys.
[/list]

[h3]Visual&Interface enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Trilinear sampling (everything is now a bit smoother).
[/list]

[h3]Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new and final Level 10.
[*] Existing level polishing - less backtracking and empty spaces.
[*] New clearer tutorial hints.
[/list]

[h3]Next steps[/h3]
[list]
[*] Preparing for a release.
[*] Fixing all critical bugs and problems.
[/list]

[b]See you later![/b]

[i]Always yours,
Power of Two team[/i]

notes.title: Patch note 0.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Remain consistent, become various[/h1]

[h2]Hopefully, we've added a lot to your game experience.[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Singleplayer! Now you can play alone, and that experience differs a lot from Cooperative. 
[*] New Rule System: unlock all kinds of game modifiers by completing levels and see how they can change your gameplay: from "Noir Mode" to "Shooter Mode." Please keep in mind that it is the first iteration of this feature, unfinished and raw. We need your feedback.
[*] Game mode switching: Zen Mode for calm and meditative gameplay, True Mode for fun and dynamic. Zen Mode is enabled by default.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Small bugs fixed here and there.
[/list]

[h3]Visual&Interface enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] New game menu one more (and not the last) time.
[*] New "Choose a Player"-screen.
[/list]

[h3]Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*] Narrative pieces deleted from all levels. They were superfluous. We will make something better.
[*] Existing level polishing.
[/list]

[h3]Development[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rule System is easily expandable.
[/list]

[h3]Next steps[/h3]
[list]
[*] Polish everything
[*] Polish one more time
[*] Polish until all feels good
[/list]

[b]See you later![/b]

[i]Always yours,
Power of Two team[/i]

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
[h3]First of all, New Year Wishes.[/h3]
Let us wish you all... All!
Have a nice life, make decisions, find what you need and what you don't know you need. 

[h3]Second of all, about our current development status.[/h3]
We are currently working on a system that allows us to change gameplay in a clear, fun, and random way - so-called "Rule modifiers" which you can unlock by completing levels, and which after unlocking will influence your gameplay in an unexpected manner.

Parallel to this, we are adding "narrative bits" - trash or fun moments just to make you smile or be surprised. Have you already met our first character?

There are big tasks, not for 1-week development, but they are worth it. 

[b]We are still here. We are working to make at least a good game.[/b]

[i]Happy New Year,
Always yours,
Power of Two team[/i]

notes.title: Patch note 0.0.3
notes.content:
[h1]That is fun is right[/h1]

[h2]We've dramatically changed the pace of our game. And narrative as well.[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] All enemies are now 4 (four!) times faster. That changes... Everything. For those of you who don't like such kind of challenge, we've added the button "Zen mode" in Main Menu.
[*] Narrative conception is undergoing a rebirth. It's quirky, but it feels fun, and we see potential in it. 
[*] The whole game is back on English. 
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dash is now working correctly with gamepad movement.
[/list]

[h3]Visual enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] New game menu!
[*] The very first in-game character...
[/list]

[h3]Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*] Little narrative moments here and there. Nothing serious, but we'll work in that direction.
[*] Existing levels adaptation for the new "hardcore" gameplay model.
[/list]

[h3]Development[/h3]
[list]
[*] New checkpoint system for easier gameplay manipulation.
[/list]

[h3]Next steps[/h3]
[list]
[*] Development of the narrative. We are going to make it fun, at least.
[*] Searching for new fun experiences within the existing structure.
[*] UI, bug fixing, etc.
[/list]

[b]See you later![/b]

[i]Always yours,
Power of Two team[/i]

notes.title: Patch note 0.0.2
notes.content:
[h1]We're finally here with the very second patch. Eh, that doesn't sound...[/h1]

[h2]Experimental gameplay-influencing narrative![/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]

[list]

[/list]

[h3]Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*] Narrative through all existing levels (only on Russian for now, sorry).
[*] Existing levels polishing.
[/list]

[h3]Development[/h3]
[list]
[*] New checkpoint system for easier gameplay manipulation.
[/list]

[h3]Next steps[/h3]
[list]
[*] Localization system (English first).
[*] Death & Level completion screen.
[*] More levels or new cooperative mechanics... Again.
[/list]

[b]See you later![/b]

[i]Always yours,
Power of Two team[/i]

notes.title: Patch note 0.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]We're finally here with the very first patch.[/h1]

[h2]We've focused on gameplay-influencing bugs and flows, and this is what we've achieved.[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "Press any button to join"-phase on the first level after launch. 
[*] Added two gamepads support.
[*] Added additional gamepad bindings: any button on the left side can be used to dash, any button on the right side can be used to push.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] No more players flying through level geometry (walls, in particular).
[*] No more "frozen" enemies.
[*] No more "checkpoint lags", your progress saves immediately.
[*] No more not working gamepads on the first and the last levels.
[/list]

[h3]Visual enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Play comfortably with your aspect ratio: two vertical black lines on the borders are removed.
[*] Active and inactive enemies are now easier to distinguish: inactive enemies are desaturated, while active ones are bright and gay.
[/list]

[h3]Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*] Start progression became smoother - we've added additional tutorial levels and remake some of the existing ones.
[*] More checkpoint throughout levels - less frustration.
[/list]

[h3]Development[/h3]
[list]
[*] New and faster level creating method using tilemaps.
[/list]

[h3]Next steps[/h3]
[list]
[*] Level completion timer and statistics.
[*] Death screen.
[*] New cooperative mechanics.
[/list]

[b]See you later![/b]

[i]Always yours,
Power of Two team[/i]

notes.title: Early Access is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]We are happy to announce that the game is now available for everyone!
Grab your friend, play together, and tell us about your experience.[/h3]

That is clearly an important step, but still only one of many forthcoming. 
Many evenings will we spend fixing bugs and polishing existing content.

But our next big step is to focus on gameplay diversity, starting from strengthening the cooperative experience. [b]That is exactly where you can play the most important role, both with your feedback and ideas. [/b]
[list]
[*] New level mechanics?
[*] Quirky enemy types? 
[*] Mindblowing player abilities? 
[/list]
[b]Cool, go on, and talk about it! [/b] We don't propose friendship to you, but instead even more - creative collaboration.

So, why not to try?

[b]Hold tight your friend in one hand and mouse or gamepad in another, and find out where this path will lead us![/b]

[i]Always yours,
Power of Two team[/i]
